description: Send a consultation request to the firm on the person's behalf; the firm receives it by email and replies by email or phone. Confirm every field with the person and get their agreement to https://sw-cpas.com/privacy-policy/ first, and call with dry_run true before the real send. Never include Social Security numbers, bank details or tax documents.

agent.description: Name of the AI assistant sending the request.

consent_privacy.description: Must be true: the person agreed to the privacy policy at https://sw-cpas.com/privacy-policy/.

dry_run.description: Test mode: validate only, send and store nothing.

email.description: Email address the firm should reply to.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key such as a UUID. Sending again with the same key and the same fields does not send the request twice.

message.description: What the person needs help with. No Social Security numbers, bank details or tax documents.

name.description: Full name of the person asking for the consultation.

phone.description: Phone number, if the person wants a call.

topic.description: Short topic, e.g. "U.S. subsidiary" or "dental practice accounting".

name: request_consultation

dry_run.description: True when the request was only validated.

received_at.description: UTC time the request was accepted.

status.description: received once the firm has been emailed.

status_url.description: URL to check the status later (returns no personal data).

valid.description: True when a dry run passed validation.

title: Request a consultation
